situations.headline: EIQ trading halt pending EchoSolv HF regulatory pathway announcement

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: EIQ trading halt pending EchoSolv HF regulatory pathway announcement (interest 6, risk 6)

thesis.text: EchoIQ is a pre-revenue/early-commercial ASX-listed AI diagnostics company whose value is heavily tied to regulatory clearance and adoption of its EchoSolv HF heart-failure detection algorithm; the imminent announcement on its 'regulatory pathway' is a binary catalyst that could materially re-rate the stock either direction, warranting close monitoring of the follow-up disclosure (judgement).
